structure.unit: Food and Drink; Weights and Measures

law.catch_line: Only suitable, tested and approved weighing devices to be used
law.text: When making a weight determination as provided for by this chapter a licensed public weighmaster shall use a weighing device that is of a type suitable for the weighing of the amount and kind of material to be weighed, and that has been tested and approved for use by a weights and measures officer of the Commonwealth within a period of 12 months immediately preceding the date of the weighing.
